details.description: Naga Gram Flour contains healthy unsaturated fats & are a reliable source of fiber. Ideal for mixing with flour for rotis & parathas or indulging your sweet tooth, this versatile flour is a staple in Indian homes. This is made with 100% chana dal and is coarsely textured to give a supreme cooking experience every time. It is packaged with the utmost care, maintaining hygiene, aroma, and purity of the besan, therefore retaining its taste. Proper steps are taken to ensure that hygiene of the besan is maintained during the packaging process.
details.usageInstructions:
Finely Ground ideal for Sweets & Savories
Ideal for making dhokla, chila, pakora, mysore pak, besan laddoo, etc
It is used in every cuisine from across the length and breadth of the country. Apart from making snacks like pakoda, dhokla, kachori, bhaji, khandvi, etc, it is also used for making meals. From chilas for breakfast to kadhi for lunch and zunka bhakri for dinner, besan is used for a variety of dishes. Apart from savoury foods, sweet dishes like besan ke laddoo, besan barfi, besan halva and mysore pak can also be prepared with besan.

details.description: Discover the authentic taste of Naga Ragi flour, made from the finest and freshest finger millet. Expertly processed using the latest hygienic technologies, this flour is a true nutritional powerhouse. Rich in protein, essential minerals, carbohydrates, calcium, and dietary fibre, it offers a superior quality that is naturally gluten-free. Ragi, an annual cereal grown across India, has long been a staple in the southern regions, particularly in Maharashtra, Goa, and Karnataka, where it is used to prepare delectable rotis and healthy porridge. Enjoy the improved digestibility and exceptional nutritional value of this versatile flour, which is bursting with vitamins, minerals, and natural fibres. Elevate your culinary creations with the wholesome goodness of Naga Ragi flour.
